typography.ui: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, system-ui

must: Keep terminal sessions alive when changing layout
Refit every visible terminal on pane resize
Support keyboard focus and reduced motion

decisions: Only Full view and Grid view. Choose tabs selects up to six existing terminals without opening shells.
Grid adjusts to the selected count: up to three side by side, four 2 by 2, five three above two, six 3 by 2.
Full view preserves the grid selection. Expanding a pane uses Full view.
Sidebar collapses to a 56px icon rail with shell chooser, status, sounds, and settings.
Full / Grid uses a compact rounded segmented button with icons, pressed state, and arrow-key navigation, matching the chat/work mode-switch pattern requested by the user.
Sidebar tabs support drag reorder and Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down. Grid pane headers can be dragged to rearrange the same sessions.
A separate pop-out window retains the same terminal process. Window close returns it to the main window; the explicit Close tab control ends the session.
evidence: 21st search attempted; service returned HTTP 401. Existing Belor primitives reused.
